The Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), also known as "One Belt One Road," is a global development strategy proposed by China. This initiative aims to enhance connectivity and cooperation among countries along and beyond the ancient Silk Road economic belt and the 21st-century Maritime Silk Road. 工程总承包模式
The Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) model, also known as 工程总承包模式, is a comprehensive project delivery system widely utilized in the international engineering construction field. This model encompasses the entire lifecycle of a project, including planning, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning. It allows for a single point of responsibility, where a single entity or a consortium takes on the complete responsibility for the project. The EPC model is characterized by its integration of design, procurement, and construction services, streamlining the process and reducing complexity. It is recognized as a mainstream project management approach, offering companies a cohesive and efficient way to manage projects. EPC总承包业务
EPC总承包业务 is a comprehensive business model that encompasses the entire spectrum of project management, including engineering, procurement, and construction services. This model is designed to provide a holistic approach to project execution, covering the planning, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases. It is a service-oriented business that offers a streamlined process for clients, ensuring that all aspects of a project are managed efficiently under one contract. The EPC总承包 business involves the design, procurement, and construction of projects, with a focus on delivering a complete solution from start to finish. This model is recognized as a comprehensive service model in project management, often referred to as a general contracting business, emphasizing its role in managing all aspects of a project's lifecycle. It is a type of business model where a single entity is responsible for the design, procurement, and construction of a project. EPC总承包业务 is also a core business of Hualu Engineering Technology Co., Ltd., and is a dynamic and evolving "galaxy" of services. Additionally, it is one of the business activities conducted by Zhongnan Institute, involving a diverse range of project types. The EPC general contracting business in a project refers to the integration of design, procurement, and construction services, which is a fundamental aspect of the company's core business operations. The model is particularly prominent in the business of China Iron and Steel Group Southern Engineering Technology Co., Ltd., reflecting its role in the company's multi-domain coordinated development. This model involves a full chain of activities, including design management, global procurement, construction organization, and debugging operation. The EPC总承包 business model involves a contractor who is fully responsible for the quality, safety, schedule, and cost of the project. This model is characterized by a single entity's responsibility for the design, procurement of materials, and construction of a project, providing a unified and efficient approach to project management. The model is particularly relevant in the field of power engineering. It is also a primary business domain for China Petroleum Engineering Corporation (CPECC). EPC总承包业务 refers to the process of managing all aspects of a project, from engineering to construction, under a single contract, ensuring a seamless and integrated approach to project execution.

Technological innovation, often referred to as "技术创新" in Chinese, is a multifaceted process that encompasses the development and implementation of new technologies. This process involves research and development activities aimed at creating new technologies and applying them to enhance products, services, and processes. The primary objectives of technological innovation are to increase efficiency, create new value, and enhance the competitiveness of products and services. This activity is not limited to enterprises alone, as it can also extend to the broader industry through the study and development of new technologies. The end goal of technological innovation is to drive industry development and foster the creation of new or improved products, services, or processes through the use of technology.

Technological innovation is a critical component in the core competitiveness of companies like Hualu Engineering Technology Co., Ltd., where it serves as one of the "planet" support systems within their EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction)总承包 business. It is a concept that supports the company's ability to deliver high-quality projects efficiently. In summary, technological innovation is a dynamic process that involves the research, development, and application of new technologies to improve efficiency, create value, and enhance competitiveness across various industries. This concept is integral to the advancement of technology in the technical field, encompassing a wide range of innovation activities. Additionally, technological innovation refers to the invention and application of new technologies, underscoring its role in driving progress and innovation.

Technological innovation is defined as the process of improving product and service technology levels through scientific research and technological development. Risk control is a comprehensive process and set of practices employed to identify, assess, and mitigate risks. It encompasses the systematic approach to managing potential threats and uncertainties that could impact various aspects of an organization or project. Specifically, risk control is a critical component within the operations of Hualu Engineering Technology Co., Ltd., where it serves as part of the "planet" support system within their Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC)总承包 business. Additionally, it is integrated into the "Big Dipper" framework, representing a key capability element for the company. In a broader context, risk control is a method used to recognize, evaluate, and alleviate potential risks, which is particularly relevant in project management scenarios. The term also refers to the risk control practices implemented by Hualu Engineering Technology Co., Ltd., highlighting its application within the company's specific context. Risk control involves the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling project risks, aiming to minimize their impact on an organization. This process is particularly relevant in project management and is characterized by its focus on recognizing, evaluating, and mitigating risks. The management of potential risks in a project is a core aspect of risk control, which is a method used to control project risks. CPECC is recognized for its core competitiveness in risk control, further emphasizing the importance of this process in various organizational contexts.

星系战略框架
The 星系战略框架 is a comprehensive strategic framework designed for analyzing business. It serves as an innovative analytical model that encompasses the strategic layout, business composition, support system, innovation path, and risk challenges of various entities, such as the Shandong Institute. This framework is particularly applied to analyze the collaborative relationships and value creation mechanisms of a company's business segments within the context of the business ecosystem. Recognized as a national think tank-level strategic recommendation, the 星系战略 framework aims to assist Hualu Company in building a sustained competitive advantage and leading the new era of engineering construction. It is a strategic analysis framework that guides the development of enterprises and is used to analyze the business landscape and competitive advantages of companies. Additionally, it is referred to as a strategic analysis tool and has been used to analyze the macro strategic positioning, strategic choices, and strategic implementation of enterprises, including the macro strategic evolution of CPECC. The framework is also known by its English translation, Galactic strategic framework.

北斗七星框架
The Beidou Seven Stars framework, also known as the Big Dipper framework, is an innovative strategic analysis tool designed to evaluate and guide the strategic layout, business composition, support system, innovation path, and risk challenges of various entities, with a particular focus on the EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) business of Hualu Company. This framework, which draws upon the refined practices of SGECL in EPC project management, is composed of seven core elements that represent the company's seven key capabilities: strategic leadership, market insight, technological innovation, project management, resource integration, risk control, and talent support. Beyond its application within Hualu Company, the Beidou Seven Stars framework serves as a strategic recommendation at the national think tank level, aiming to assist entities in building a sustained competitive advantage and leading the new era of engineering construction. It has been applied to analyze the strategic layout and business composition of the Shandong Institute, showcasing its versatility across different contexts. The framework is recognized as an analysis model and theoretical model for examining the micro-project management practices of CPECC and is also considered an analysis tool and model within the context of this report. It is a comprehensive framework analyzing the comprehensive strength and development level of enterprises from seven key dimensions.

Typically, EPC projects are associated with large-scale construction projects, such as infrastructure and buildings. These projects are characterized by a single point of responsibility for the design, procurement, and construction phases, which can lead to more efficient project management and cost control. The EPC model has been successfully applied in various sectors, including the construction of pump storage power stations and offshore wind farms, where it has contributed to significant breakthroughs, as evidenced by the achievements of Central South Institute. data.content:
中国电建集团成都勘测设计研究院有限公司
中国电建集团成都勘测设计研究院有限公司(以下简称"成都院")作为中国电建集团的核心成员单位，在水利水电、新能源等领域具有深厚的技术积累和丰富的工程经验。<SEP>中国电建集团成都勘测设计研究院有限公司是一家从事EPC总承包业务的研究院。<SEP>A subsidiary of China Electric Power Construction Corporation, mentioned in the annual report

总包创研院

本报告

改革开放
Reform and opening up<SEP>改革开放是指1978年以来中国进行的一系列经济体制改革和开放政策。<SEP>改革开放是中国工程建设领域主要沿用计划经济体制下的管理模式，设计、施工、设备采购等环节相对分离，随着市场经济体制的逐步建立和对外开放的扩大，一些大型工业项目和引进国外先进技术的项目开始尝试采用国际通行的工程总承包模式。<SEP>改革开放是中国五环工程有限公司转型为市场化运营工程公司的时代背景。<SEP>改革开放是中国历史上的一次重大社会变革，标志着中国开始向市场经济转型。<SEP>改革开放是指1978年以来，中国开始实施的一系列经济体制改革和对外开放政策。

业主
The entity referred to as "业主" is the owner or investor of a project. As the owner, they are responsible for proposing the fundamental requirements of the project and paying the contract amounts. The owner is an individual or entity that organizes and manages the project, often delegating the construction work to a general contractor. In the context of the Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC)总承包 model, the owner acts as the contracting party and is responsible for interfacing with the general contractor and managing the project. 进行
China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau responds to the new trends, challenges, and opportunities of the industry, places the development of EPC general contracting business at the core strategic position, strives for integrated capabilities of the whole industrial chain, and achieves remarkable achievements in the EPC business field, covering multiple important fields and successfully implementing a large number of significant EPC projects both at home and abroad, contributing to the modernization and internationalization of the Chinese construction industry, revealing the key elements and internal logic of successful EPC business operation of large-scale construction enterprises in complex market environments, summarizing valuable experiences and profound enlightenment in enhancing core competitiveness and realizing sustainable development

对中建五局EPC业务
The report conducts a comprehensive evaluation of the economic benefits, market performance, management performance, and social benefits of China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau's EPC business

展望
The report looks forward to the future development trends of the EPC engineering general contracting industry, analyzes the opportunities and challenges faced by China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau in the new historical period, and proposes forward-looking thoughts on the future strategic planning and innovative development direction of its EPC business

成为
The EPC model has become the mainstream model for the construction of large-scale complex engineering projects, widely promoted and deeply applied in the construction industry in China

力求数据翔实
The report strives for detailed data, rich cases, thorough analysis, and objective views

始终站在
China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau has always stood at the forefront of the reform and development of the construction industry, responded to the national strategy, placed the development of EPC general contracting business at the core strategic position, and promoted the modernization and internationalization of the Chinese construction industry

为
The report is intended to provide a professional reference with depth and breadth for managers in the construction industry, EPC project practitioners, policymakers, academic researchers, and all stakeholders concerned about the development of the Chinese construction industry

对
The EPC model puts forward unprecedented high requirements for the comprehensive strength and management level of engineering construction enterprises

致力于
China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau is committed to building integrated capabilities of the whole industrial chain and an EPC brand image with "design leading, technology advanced, management excellent, and contract reliable"

希望通过对中建五局
This research report hopes to reveal the key elements and internal logic of successful EPC business operation of large-scale construction enterprises in complex market environments through the in-depth research of China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau, a typical sample, and summarize valuable experiences and profound enlightenment in enhancing core competitiveness and realizing sustainable development

经过
After years of exploration and practice, China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau has achieved remarkable achievements in the EPC business field, covering multiple important fields and successfully implementing a large number of significant EPC projects, contributing to the modernization and internationalization of the Chinese construction industry
